FULL TEXT:
REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.- 02/R&A Dated: 16th January, 2026
The Skill Test for the Regular Mazdoor Recruitment Examination, 2025 (under
Advertisement No. PHC/01/2025) in respect of 3498 candidates was conducted from 23rd to
29th December, 2025 excluding 25th December, 2025.
Out of these, 3229 candidates appeared in the Skill Test, while 269 candidates
remained absent. In accordance with the provisions of the advertisement, only these 3229
candidates who appeared shall be invited to participate in the Interview.
The interview of these shortlisted candidates shall be conducted from 02.02.2026 to
11.02.2026 (excluding 08.02.2026), within the premises of the Court. The exact date of
interview, reporting time, and venue shall be mentioned in their respective Admit Cards
(Interview Letters).
The admit cards for the interview shall be made available by 27.01.2026, which may be
downloaded, using login credentials, from the official website of the High Court:
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in/notices/recruitments/. The candidates may also be intimated, in
this regard, through SMS and e-mail on their registered mobile number and e-mail ID
respectively. The Admit Card shall not be sent to the candidates separately through any other
mode.
Prior to appearing in the Interview, candidates shall mandatorily undergo Document
Verification, for which they shall produce the original certificates along with one self-attested
photocopy of each certificate, in support of their candidature (as detailed in the advertisement).
The required documents are as follows:
1. Proof of Age: Matriculation Certificate, Birth Certificate, or any other valid certificate.
2. Educational Qualification: Marksheet and certificates supporting the prescribed
eligibility criteria.
3. Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable):
• For SC/ST candidates: Caste Certificate.
P a g e | 2
• For BC/EBC candidates: Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate (issued for
employment in Bihar).
• For EWS candidates: Income & Asset Certificate.
4. PwBD Certificate: for OH category candidates.
5. Domicile (Permanent Residence) Certificate: for candidates claiming reservation
under SC/ST/BC/EBC/EWS category.
These certificates should be valid as on the date of submission of their online
application form for the post of Regular Mazdoor.
Candidates must ensure that all requisite certificates to substantiate their
candidature, as per their application, are kept ready prior to the scheduled date of
interview. They are further advised to carefully read the Advertisement in detail.
Any candidate who fails to produce the Domicile Certificate and the
Caste/Category/NCL/Income & Asset Certificate, as prescribed in the advertisement,
shall not be entitled to the benefits of reservation. Such candidates shall be treated
as Unreserved (UR) category candidates, and their candidature shall be assessed
under the Unreserved category across all stages of the current recruitment exercise.
Besides, candidates claiming candidature under the OH category shall
undergo a medical examination by a Medical Board, so constituted at the time of the
interview, for determining the nature and percentage of disability/disabilities.
Candidature of the shortlisted candidates shall be provisional, subject to their being
found eligible in all respects in accordance with the provisions of the advertisement and the
relevant rules. If, at any stage, it is found that a candidate does not fulfill any of the eligibility
conditions notified in the advertisement, his/her candidature shall be cancelled.
The candidates are hereby directed to strictly adhere to the schedule of the Interview
and to comply with the instructions specified in the Admit Card (Interview Letter). Requests
for any change in the Interview schedule shall not be entertained under any circumstances.
No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the Interview.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s official website regularly for
further details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P. K. Malik
Registrar General
